_meta.name: SP4 Self-Preservation Four — Counter-Type Clean Confirmation
_meta.description: Self-Preservation Four. HIGH confidence. Stage 1 canonical rankings: Heart center dominant (18/9/9), SP instinct dominant (18/12/6). Stage 1 flags SP-4 Tenacity counter-type. Stage 2 cross-reference lands cleanly on Type 4 (Withdrawn/Intensity/Frustration), confirming the counter-type and routing Stage 3 to CT mode (SP 4 vs Type 3). Stage 3 clean A — confirms Type 4. Stage 4 Option A confirms cleanly. Section 1A (counter-type) should appear in coach report. Section 6A should NOT appear.

stage0.q1: I feel things very deeply, I'm drawn to authenticity and beauty, and I struggle with feeling misunderstood or like something essential is missing in me
stage0.q2: creative, intense, self-absorbed at times, but very genuine and committed
stage0.q3: emotional depth and the ability to connect authentically with what is real and meaningful
stage0.q4: envy — a persistent sense that others have something I lack, which can pull me away from what I actually have

stage2.ambiguityAxis: All three Stage 2 frameworks land on Type 4's signature: Withdrawn (Hornevian), Intensity (Harmonic), Frustration (Object Relations). No competing type signal — Stage 2 cleanly confirms the SP-4 counter-type combination flagged in Stage 1.

stage4.stressDescription: Picked the canonical Type 4 answer — under stress the client moves toward Type 2 territory, becoming overly attentive to others' needs and setting aside their own, seeking appreciation in the process. This matched Type 4's stress point cleanly.
stage4.securityDescription: Picked the canonical Type 4 answer — in ease the client moves toward Type 1, becoming more grounded, disciplined, and action-oriented, stopping the dwell on what's missing and starting to do with a clearer sense of what's right. This matched Type 4's security point cleanly.
